correctness.rationale: Derive an absolutely convergent cyclic generating function from the exact rational stability map and obtain a closed entry formula. All entries are nonnegative iff H_n is. For n=2,3,4 every degree-n Bernstein coefficient on two half intervals is exactly positive; the standalone checker verifies all coefficients. For n>=5 Descartes gives at most two positive roots, while H_n(0)=1, H_n(1)=n and an exact negative common witness prove two simple roots and the exact disconnected step set. Fixed-parameter and boundary-scale limits rigorously give the stated two asymptotics. The 367 exact checker assertions have been replayed; no infinite assertion rests on finite sampling.

value.rationale: The discrete periodic upwind operator is a canonical transport semidiscretization. An exact nonmonotone step interval for a classical L-stable second-order method clarifies the meaning and limitations of general SSP sufficient restrictions. The five-state cutoff, all-cycle necessary-and-sufficient two-root classification, exact all-size negative witness and linear asymptotic upper boundary constitute a motivated structural answer rather than a routine parameter substitution or isolated computation.
